roamingDeferred.reason: meinLadestrom can also be used at roaming-partner charging points, but the official price sheet warns that partner costs can differ by charging point and provider and are displayed in eCharge+ before charging. Keep roaming separate from physical Stadtwerke Bielefeld CPO offers and never attach it to third-party operators.

adHocDeferred.reason: The official page confirms contract-free app payment but publishes no universal ad-hoc price; the current price is shown in eCharge+ before the session. Do not infer the meinLadestrom contract tariff.

networkEvidence.policy: Attach the four meinLadestrom offers only to physical Stadtwerke Bielefeld sites. Re-audit if a site outside Nordrhein-Westfalen appears.

deferred.blockingFee: The current official price sheet and AGB publish no blocking or idle fee. No such fee is fabricated in the direct offers.
